units.source: A custom resource provider allows any file imported into Trilium (images, fonts, stylesheets) to be publicly accessible via a URL.
A potential use case for this is to add embed a custom font alongside a theme.
Steps for creating a custom resource provider__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Custom Resource Providers > Steps for creating a custom resource provider

units.source: Import a file such as an image or a font into Trilium by drag & drop.

units.source: To test if it is working, use a browser to navigate to __TRILIUM_PH_0__ (where __TRILIUM_PH_1__ is either __TRILIUM_PH_2__ or __TRILIUM_PH_3__ based on your setup, and __TRILIUM_PH_4__ is the host or IP to your Trilium server instance). If you are running the TriliumNext application without a server, use __TRILIUM_PH_5__ as the base URL.
units.context: Custom Resource Providers > Steps for creating a custom resource provider

units.source: If everything went well, at the previous step the browser should have downloaded the file uploaded in the first step.

units.source: As a more advanced use case, a regular expression to match multiple routes, such as __TRILIUM_PH_0__ which will be accessible via __TRILIUM_PH_1__, __TRILIUM_PH_2__, __TRILIUM_PH_3__, etc.
